C-17.Name: Markdown hygiene: markdownlint-subset validation + Format document (matrix P0-A/P0-B)
C-17.Summary: The two medium-effort P0 gaps from docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md, both serving the Mark thesis "your agent writes markdown — Mark keeps it readable": P0-A live validation with a markdownlint-style rule subset (red squiggles in the WYSIWYG surface), P0-B Format document that canonicalizes headings/lists/tables/spacing on demand through the existing export/import pipeline (getMarkdown → normalize → setMarkdown with a single undoable history entry).

Problem.Description: Agent-generated markdown arrives with heading-level jumps (MD001), inconsistent heading style (MD003), trailing spaces (MD009), duplicate top-level headings/multiple H1 (MD025), missing blank lines around lists/headings (MD032), and broken link/image references (MD040-class). Mark neither flags nor fixes these; VS Code shows both via extensions.
Problem.RootCause: No validation pass exists over muya's block tree, and no canonicalizing formatter exists — the renderer can already round-trip markdown (ExportMarkdown/ImportMarkdown in muya), but nothing applies lint rules or normalizes structure on demand.
Problem.Evidence: docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md Quality & formatting rows (markdownlint ❌, Format document ❌, both marked P0); muya contentState exposes getBlocks()/getMarkdown() sufficient for both features; no markdownlint/prettier dependency in package.json (and Constraint: none will be added — the npm markdownlint packages are heavy and pull their own parser; rules run on muya blocks instead).

Goals.R-1: P0-A validator module (renderer, pure): rule subset MD001 (heading increments), MD003 (heading style consistency), MD009 (trailing spaces), MD025 (single H1), MD032 (blank lines around blocks), MD040-class (fenced code language present). Input: muya block tree; output: [{ rule, blockKey, range, message }]. Deterministic, unit table-driven per rule.
Goals.R-2: P0-A surface: red squiggle decoration + rule hint on flagged spans in the WYSIWYG surface, recomputed on document change (debounced), no interference with editing/undo; toggleable via a preference (default on).
Goals.R-3: P0-B Format document command (Cmd+Shift+F / Format menu): normalizes heading cascade, list spacing, blank-line structure, trailing whitespace, and table column alignment via a formatter module over the block tree; applied as ONE undoable history entry; never changes content semantics (text, links, code contents untouched).
Goals.R-4: Both features share the rule/normalizer core so a rule and its fix cannot drift apart (the formatter consumes the same rule definitions).

Constraints.Constraint: No new npm runtime dependencies — rules/formatter implemented over muya blocks in-repo.
Validation is advisory-only: no auto-fix on paste/save in this change (Format document is the explicit fix path).
Formatter must be idempotent (format twice = format once) and semantics-preserving — pinned by property-style tests over fixture documents.

Scoped 100% coverage of the new validator/formatter modules; e2e visual gate (squiggle visible on a fixture with a heading jump; Format produces expected canonical text); grace lint zero findings; two sequential reviews.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Full markdownlint rule parity (config files, inline pragma comments) — subset above only.
Quick-fix lightbulbs per squiggle (follow-up once validation ships).
Source-mode (CodeMirror) lint integration — WYSIWYG surface first.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: each rule fires/does-not-fire on table fixtures; formatter canonicalizes fixtures idempotently; semantics-preserved fixtures (code blocks, links) unchanged.
Visual e2e: a document with a heading jump shows a squiggle decoration; Format document via menu/bus canonicalizes the visible text; undo restores the original in one step.
Preference toggle hides/shows validation without reload.
Full suite green; two sequential reviews (correctness; contracts/security) clean.

AffectedAreas.M-012: muya: block-tree validation hooks + decoration rendering lane
AffectedAreas.M-011: editor.vue: Format document command wiring + preference
AffectedAreas.M-014: command registry / Format menu entry (cmd registry prune aware)

C-17.VerificationIntent: Unit: per-rule table tests + formatter idempotence suite. Visual: new Playwright spec (squiggle + format + undo). Governance: V-M-012/M-011 verification deltas at implementation time; new validator module gets its own graph entry.
